question: Predominant theme of Manipuri dance is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**devotion.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The predominant theme of** Manipuri dance** is **devotion,** particularly towards** Lord Krishna and Radha.**
 
• The dance form originated in the **northeastern state of Manipur **and is known for its** graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive gestures.**
 
• Manipuri dance also has elements of **nature and mythology **woven into its themes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Warfare **is not a predominant theme in **Manipuri dance** but may be depicted in some dances that showcase the **martial arts of Manipur.**
 
• **Patriotism** may be reflected in some dances that celebrate the culture and traditions of Manipur.
 
• **Bravery** may be depicted in some dances that showcase the courage of Manipuri warriors in battles.
